provenance.description: Paraphrased questions over the isolated test-fixture corpus. Gold is an exact quote; every corpus document containing it counts as gold. Small corpus: document-level recall@8 is near-trivial; passage visibility to the judge is the informative signal. Not a measure of large-library recall.
